1878	        records are re-verified on restart; it never splices in (or depends on)
1879	        the current canonical chain, so a same-key retry stays verifiable after
1880	        the receiver's canonical chain has advanced. The tail must be a
1881	        non-empty list of well-formed blocks whose heights start at
1882	        ``anchor.height + 1`` and stay consecutive, whose first ``prev_hash``
1883	        is the anchor hash (later ones linking internally), with
1884	        recomputed-correct Merkle roots and block hashes, valid Ed25519
1885	        signatures, tx_ids unique within the tail and ascending inside each
1886	        block, and pending status only on its final block. Endowment replay is
1887	        not part of this standalone check (it needs the canonical-prefix
1888	        balances and is run on the assembled chain at first reception).
1889	        Raises ValueError on any defect and returns the parsed tail Blocks.
1890	        """
1891	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
1892	            raise ValueError("'blocks' must be a non-empty list")
1893	        tail: list[Block] = []
1894	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
1895	        expected_prev = anchor["block_hash"]
1896	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
1897	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
1898	                raise ValueError(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
1899	            try:
1900	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
1901	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
1902	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}") from exc
1903	            expected_height = anchor["height"] + 1 + i
1904	            if isinstance(block.height, bool) or block.height != expected_height:
1905	                raise ValueError(
1906	                    f"block at position {i} has height {block.height}, "
1907	                    f"expected {expected_height}"
1908	                )
1909	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
1910	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has a mismatched prev_hash")
1911	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
1912	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
1913	            if i < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
1914	                raise ValueError(f"pending block {i} is not the chain tip")
1915	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
1916	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
1917	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions must be a list")
1918	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
1919	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
1920	                LedgerStore._valid_tx_fields(tx)
1921	                if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
1922	                    raise ValueError(
1923	                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has an invalid signature"
1924	                    )
1925	                stored_id = (
1926	                    txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
1927	                )
1928	                if stored_id != tx.tx_id:
1929	                    raise ValueError(
1930	                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has a mismatched tx_id"
1931	                    )
1932	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
1933	                    raise ValueError(
1934	                        f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in range delivery"
1935	                    )
1936	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
1937	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
1938	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
1939	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
1940	            if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != block.merkle_root:
1941	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} Merkle root mismatch")
1942	            if (
1943	                compute_block_hash(block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root)
1944	                != block.block_hash
1945	            ):
1946	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} block_hash mismatch")
1947	            expected_prev = block.block_hash

1951	    @staticmethod
1952	    def range_fingerprint(anchor: dict, tail: list[Block]) -> str:
1953	        """SHA-256 content fingerprint of a delivered range (anchor + tail).
1954	
1955	        Covers exactly what the sender delivered — never the assembled
1956	        canonical prefix — so a same-key retry keeps matching after the
1957	        receiver's canonical chain has advanced.
1958	        """
1959	        payload = {
1960	            "anchor": {
1961	                "height": anchor["height"],
1962	                "block_hash": anchor["block_hash"],
1963	            },
1964	            "blocks": [block.to_dict() for block in tail],
1965	        }
1966	        return hashlib.sha256(
1967	            json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
1968	        ).hexdigest()

1970	    def _parse_persisted_forks(
1971	        self,
1972	        forks_raw: object,
1973	        canonical_chain: list[Block],
1974	        endowment: int | None = None,
1975	    ) -> dict[str, list[Block]]:
1976	        """Parse persisted candidate forks, dropping invalid ones on restart.
1977	
1978	        Every stored fork is re-validated exactly like a fresh submission
1979	        (genesis connection, hashes, Merkle roots, signatures, uniqueness,
1980	        replay). A fork that no longer validates is silently discarded rather
1981	        than failing recovery of the canonical chain. Recovery of the canonical
1982	        chain itself remains strict and still raises StateRecoveryError. The
1983	        replay uses ``endowment`` — the value recorded in this snapshot — rather
1984	        than the startup argument, so a different launch parameter cannot make
1985	        a persisted fork legal or illegal.
1986	        """
1987	        if not isinstance(forks_raw, list):
1988	            return {}
1989	        if endowment is None:
1990	            endowment = DEFAULT_INITIAL_BALANCE
1991	        genesis = canonical_chain[0]
1992	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
1993	        for entry in forks_raw:
1994	            try:
1995	                fork = self._parse_verified_chain(entry, endowment, genesis)
1996	            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
1997	                continue
1998	            if not fork or fork[0].block_hash != genesis.block_hash:
1999	                continue
2000	            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
2001	            # The canonical chain (or a strict prefix of it, matched by any
2002	            # canonical block hash) is never also stored as a candidate.
2003	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in canonical_chain):
2004	                continue
2005	            forks.setdefault(tip_hash, fork)
2006	        return forks

2008	    def replace_chain(self, new_chain: list[Block]) -> None:
2009	        """Atomically adopt a fork: swap the canonical chain, reconcile the
2010	        mempool (old-chain-only confirmed transactions return de-duplicated;
2011	        pending-block transactions never enter the pool) and rebuild indexes.
2012	        Does not save; the caller persists.
2013	        """
2014	        old_confirmed_ids = {
2015	            tx.tx_id
2016	            for block in self.chain
2017	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED
2018	            for tx in block.transactions
2019	        }
2020	        new_ids = {tx.tx_id for block in new_chain for tx in block.transactions}
2021	        old_tx_by_id = {
2022	            tx.tx_id: tx
2023	            for block in self.chain
2024	            for tx in block.transactions
2025	        }
2026	        # Transactions unique to the superseded chain's confirmed history go
2027	        # back to the mempool, de-duplicated against anything already queued.
2028	        # Transactions from the old pending tip are not in old_confirmed_ids,
2029	        # so they are dropped, never re-enqueued.
2030	        for tx_id in old_confirmed_ids - new_ids:
2031	            self.pending.setdefault(tx_id, old_tx_by_id[tx_id])
2032	        # Transactions now on the adopted chain must leave the mempool.
2033	        for tx_id in new_ids:
2034	            self.pending.pop(tx_id, None)
2035	        self.chain = new_chain
2036	        self.rebuild_derived()

2065	    def sign_checkpoint(self) -> dict | None:
2066	        """Return ``{key_version, signature}`` for the current log head.
2067	
2068	        The signature covers Ed25519(SHA256(canonical JSON of
2069	        ``{genesis_hash, checkpoint, key_version}``)) under the current audit
2070	        signer. Returns None on a legacy unsigned snapshot that has not yet
2071	        been migrated (exports then carry no checkpoint authentication).
2072	        Caller must hold the lock.
2073	        """
2074	        if self.audit_signer is None:
2075	            return None
2076	        signature = audit.sign_checkpoint_auth(
2077	            self.audit_signer["private_key"],
2078	            self.chain[0].block_hash,
2079	            self.audit_checkpoint,
2080	            self.audit_signer["version"],
2081	        )
2082	        # A locally generated/validated key cannot fail; treat it as a
2083	        # programming error rather than emitting an unsigned export.
2084	        if signature is None:
2085	            raise RuntimeError("current audit signer key is invalid")
2086	        return {
2087	            "key_version": self.audit_signer["version"],
2088	            "signature": signature,
2089	        }

2091	    def append_audit_event(self, kind: str, payload: dict, at: float | None = None) -> dict:
2092	        """Append an audit event in memory with the next monotonic event_id.
2093	
2094	        The event's ``prev_hash``/``event_hash`` links are computed against
2095	        the current log head so the append-only hash chain stays continuous.
2096	        The in-memory checkpoint is advanced together with the event; the
2097	        caller persists the event, the link and the checkpoint in the same
2098	        atomic write as the state change the event describes. Caller must
2099	        hold the lock.
2100	        """
2101	        prev_hash = (
2102	            self.audit_checkpoint["event_hash"]
2103	            if self.audit_events
2104	            else audit.ZERO_HASH
2105	        )
2106	        event = {
2107	            "event_id": len(self.audit_events) + 1,
2108	            "kind": kind,
2109	            "at": time.time() if at is None else at,
2110	            "prev_hash": prev_hash,
2111	        }
2112	        event.update(payload)
2113	        event["event_hash"] = audit.event_hash(prev_hash, event)
2114	        self.audit_events.append(event)
2115	        self.audit_checkpoint = audit.make_checkpoint(self.audit_events)
2116	        return event

2118	    def truncate_audit_events(self, count: int) -> None:
2119	        """Remove the last ``count`` appended events and reset the checkpoint.
2120	
2121	        Used by callers to roll an append back when the accompanying atomic
2122	        write fails: the log, its hash head and the checkpoint always move
2123	        together, so the checkpoint must return to the new (old) head.
2124	        Caller must hold the lock.
2125	        """
2126	        if count:
2127	            del self.audit_events[len(self.audit_events) - count :]
2128	        self.audit_checkpoint = audit.make_checkpoint(self.audit_events)

2130	    def prune_syncs(
2131	        self, now: float | None = None
2132	    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[tuple[str, str], dict]]:
2133	        """Drop expired sync records in memory.
2134	
2135	        A record expires once ``expires_at`` has passed. Returns the orphaned
2136	        tip hashes together with every removed record (keyed by
2137	        ``(source, request_id)``) so the caller can persist the sweep
2138	        atomically and restore the pre-cleanup state if that write fails.
2139	        Tips adopted onto the canonical chain are not present in ``forks`` and
2140	        are simply skipped when the caller reconciles them. Does not save; the
2141	        caller persists.
2142	        """
2143	        current = time.time() if now is None else now

1	"""Ledger business logic: submit transactions, mine blocks, query state,
2	and drive the confirm/rollback block state machine.
3	
4	Block lifecycle
5	---------------
6	The genesis block is born ``confirmed``. Mining (POST /v1/blocks) is only
7	allowed when the chain tip is confirmed and the mempool is non-empty; it
8	produces a ``pending`` block. A pending tip can then be *confirmed* (making
9	its transactions count toward balances and proofs) or *rolled back* (the
10	block is deleted and its transactions return to the mempool de-duplicated).
11	Only the tip can ever be pending, so a confirmed block is final.
12	
13	Balance convention
14	------------------
15	The contract defines no minting endpoint, so every identity starts with a
16	fixed endowment (``initial_balance``, overridable via LEDGER_INITIAL_BALANCE).
17	An account's confirmed balance is::
18	
19	    initial_balance + sum(confirmed amounts received) - sum(confirmed amounts sent)
20	
21	Only confirmed blocks count. The reported balance additionally subtracts the
22	account's spends sitting in the pending (unconfirmed) tip block — pending
23	*credits* are deliberately not counted. An identity only becomes a *queryable
24	account* once it appears in a confirmed block; GET account before that
25	returns 404. Balance checks at submission time treat an identity that has
26	never appeared on chain as holding the initial endowment, otherwise the first
27	transaction in an empty ledger could never be accepted.
28	"""

30

32	import json
33	import time

43	
44	# Audit event kinds. The log is append-only: trust lifecycle changes
45	# (registered/rotated/revoked) and inter-node sync events
46	# (received/adopted/expired) are all recorded permanently.
47	EVENT_SOURCE_REGISTERED = "source_registered"

57	    """Strict decimal height parse; None when malformed."""

60	        if str(height_int) != str(height).strip():
61	            raise ValueError

67	def _parse_decimal(value: object) -> int | None:
68	    """Strict non-negative decimal parse; None when malformed.
69	
70	    Only ``0`` or a digit string whose first digit is non-zero is accepted:
71	    leading zeros, signs, whitespace and non-string types are all rejected.
72	    """
73	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
74	        return None
75	    if value != "0" and (not value.isdigit() or value[0] == "0"):
76	        return None

80	class LedgerService:
81	    def __init__(self, store: LedgerStore, initial_balance: int = DEFAULT_INITIAL_BALANCE) -> None:
82	        self.store = store
83	        # The snapshot-recorded endowment is the only balance-replay / balance
84	        # reporting parameter: a recovered store already knows its endowment, so
85	        # restarting with a different --initial-balance must not change any
86	        # legality or reported balance. Only a brand-new store (no recorded
87	        # value) adopts the constructor argument.
88	        if store.initial_balance is None:
89	            store.initial_balance = initial_balance
90	            self.initial_balance = initial_balance

94	    # -- transactions -------------------------------------------------------
95	
96	    def submit_transaction(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
97	        """Validate and enqueue a transaction. Returns (status, body)."""
98	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
99	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
100	        for field in REQUIRED_TX_FIELDS:
101	            if field not in payload:
102	                return 400, {"error": f"missing field: {field}"}
103	
104	        sender = payload["from"]
105	        recipient = payload["to"]
106	        amount = payload["amount"]
107	        signature = payload["signature"]
108	
109	        if not isinstance(sender, str) or not sender:
110	            return 400, {"error": "field 'from' must be a non-empty string"}
111	        if not isinstance(recipient, str) or not recipient:
112	            return 400, {"error": "field 'to' must be a non-empty string"}
113	        # bool is a subclass of int: reject it and all non-int types explicitly.
114	        if not isinstance(amount, int) or isinstance(amount, bool) or amount <= 0:
115	            return 400, {"error": "field 'amount' must be a positive integer"}
116	        if not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature:
117	            return 400, {"error": "field 'signature' must be a non-empty string"}
118	
119	        message = crypto.canonical_message(sender, recipient, amount)
120	        if not crypto.verify_signature(sender, message, signature):
121	            return 400, {"error": "invalid signature"}
122	
123	        tx = Transaction(sender, recipient, amount, signature)
124	        with self.store.lock:
125	            if tx.tx_id in self.store.pending:
126	                return 409, {"error": "transaction already pending", "tx_id": tx.tx_id}
127	            if any(tx.tx_id == existing.tx_id for block in self.store.chain for existing in block.transactions):
128	                return 409, {"error": "transaction already confirmed", "tx_id": tx.tx_id}
129	            if self.available_balance(sender) < amount:
130	                return 400, {"error": "insufficient balance"}
131	            self.store.pending[tx.tx_id] = tx
132	            try:
133	                self.store.save()
134	            except BaseException:
135	                # Persistence failed: drop the in-memory enqueue so memory
136	                # keeps matching the last durably committed state.
137	                self.store.pending.pop(tx.tx_id, None)
138	                raise
139	        return 202, {"tx_id": tx.tx_id}

143	    def mine_block(self) -> tuple[int, dict]:
144	        """Pack all pending transactions (ascending tx_id) into a pending block.
145	
146	        Only allowed when the chain tip is confirmed; the new block becomes
147	        the pending tip until it is confirmed or rolled back.
148	        """
149	        with self.store.lock:
150	            if self.store.tip_is_pending():
151	                return 409, {"error": "tip block is pending confirmation"}
152	            if not self.store.pending:
153	                return 409, {"error": "no pending transactions"}
154	            ordered = sorted(self.store.pending.values(), key=lambda tx: tx.tx_id)
155	            block = Block.create(
156	                height=self.store.next_height(),
157	                prev_hash=self.store.tip_hash(),
158	                transactions=ordered,
159	                status=STATUS_PENDING,
160	            )
161	            self.store.chain.append(block)
162	            removed = [self.store.pending.pop(tx.tx_id) for tx in ordered]
163	            try:
164	                self.store.save()
165	            except BaseException:
166	                # Undo the in-memory block so nothing un-persisted is visible.
167	                self.store.chain.pop()
168	                self.store.pending.update({tx.tx_id: tx for tx in removed})
169	                raise
170	        return 201, {
171	            "height": block.height,
172	            "block_hash": block.block_hash,
173	            "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,
174	            "status": block.status,
175	        }

177	    def get_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
178	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
179	        if height_int is None:
180	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
181	        with self.store.lock:
182	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
183	            if block is None:
184	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
185	            return 200, block.to_summary()

187	    def get_block_status(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
188	        """GET /v1/blocks/{height}/status -> {height, status}; 404 if unknown."""
189	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
190	        if height_int is None:
191	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
192	        with self.store.lock:
193	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
194	            if block is None:
195	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
196	            return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": block.status}

198	    def confirm_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
199	        """Confirm a pending tip block.
200	
201	        Only a pending chain tip whose parent is confirmed can be confirmed.
202	        Confirming an already-confirmed block is idempotent (200); every
203	        other case — unknown or malformed height, non-tip pending block —
204	        returns 409.
205	        """
206	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
207	        with self.store.lock:
208	            if height_int is None:
209	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
210	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
211	            if block is None:
212	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
213	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
214	                # Idempotent re-confirm.
215	                return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}
216	            if block is not self.store.tip():
217	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be confirmed"}
218	            parent = self.store.chain[-2] if len(self.store.chain) >= 2 else None
219	            if parent is None or parent.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
220	                return 409, {"error": "previous block is not confirmed"}
221	            block.status = STATUS_CONFIRMED
222	            try:
223	                self.store.save()
224	            except BaseException:
225	                block.status = STATUS_PENDING
226	                raise
227	            return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}
228	
229	    def rollback_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
230	        """Roll back a pending tip block: delete it and restore its transactions.
231	
232	        Unknown or malformed heights (including an already-rolled-back
233	        height) return 404; a confirmed block or a non-tip block returns 409.
234	        """
235	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
236	        if height_int is None:
237	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
238	        with self.store.lock:
239	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
240	            if block is None:
241	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
242	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
243	                return 409, {"error": "confirmed block cannot be rolled back"}
244	            if block is not self.store.tip():
245	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be rolled back"}
246	            pending_before = set(self.store.pending)
247	            rolled_back = self.store.rollback_tip()
248	            try:
249	                self.store.save()
250	            except BaseException:
251	                # Restore the block and drop only the mempool entries we added.
252	                self.store.chain.append(rolled_back)
253	                for tx_id in list(self.store.pending):
254	                    if tx_id not in pending_before:
255	                        del self.store.pending[tx_id]
256	                raise
257	            return 200, {"height": rolled_back.height, "status": "rolled_back"}

259	    def get_proof(self, height: object, tx_id: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
260	        """Return a Merkle inclusion proof for tx_id at the given height.
261	
262	        Returns 404 for an unknown height, a malformed height/tx_id, or a
263	        transaction absent from that block. Proofs are only issued for
264	        confirmed blocks; a pending block returns 409.
265	        """
266	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
267	        if height_int is None:
268	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
269	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id):
270	            return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
271	        with self.store.lock:
272	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
273	            if block is None:
274	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
275	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
276	                return 409, {"error": "block is pending confirmation"}
277	            tx_ids = [tx.tx_id for tx in block.transactions]
278	            try:
279	                index = tx_ids.index(tx_id)
280	            except ValueError:
281	                return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
282	            siblings = crypto.merkle_proof(tx_ids, index)
283	            return 200, {
284	                "height": block.height,
285	                "tx_id": tx_id,
286	                "index": index,
287	                "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,
288	                "block_hash": block.block_hash,
289	                "siblings": siblings,
290	            }

294	    def get_account(self, account: str) -> tuple[int, dict]:
295	        with self.store.lock:
296	            entry = self.store.accounts.get(account)
297	            if entry is None:
298	                return 404, {"error": "account not found"}
299	            return 200, {
300	                "account": account,
301	                "balance": self.reported_balance(account),

305	    def confirmed_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
306	        """Balance from confirmed blocks only."""
307	        entry = self.store.accounts.get(account)
308	        if entry is None:
309	            return self.initial_balance
310	        return self.initial_balance + entry["received"] - entry["sent"]
311	
312	    def reported_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
313	        """Confirmed balance minus spends sitting in the pending tip block.
314	
315	        Pending-block credits are not counted: unconfirmed income can still
316	        be rolled back, so it must not inflate the reported balance.
317	        """
318	        balance = self.confirmed_balance(account)
319	        tip = self.store.tip()
320	        if tip.status == STATUS_PENDING:
321	            for tx in tip.transactions:
322	                if tx.sender == account:
323	                    balance -= tx.amount
324	        return balance
325	
326	    def available_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
327	        """Reported balance minus amounts already committed in the mempool.
328	
329	        Pending credits (mempool or unconfirmed block) are deliberately not
330	        counted, so a sequence of submissions cannot spend money that has not
331	        been confirmed yet.
332	        """
333	        balance = self.reported_balance(account)
334	        for tx in self.store.pending.values():
335	            if tx.sender == account:
336	                balance -= tx.amount
337	        return balance

339	    # -- fork candidates -----------------------------------------------------
340	
341	    @staticmethod
342	    def _fork_summary(blocks: list) -> dict:
343	        """Public fork descriptor S: tip_hash, height, length, status."""
344	        tip = blocks[-1]
345	        return {
346	            "tip_hash": tip.block_hash,
347	            "height": tip.height,
348	            # The length counts every block including the genesis block.
349	            "length": len(blocks),
350	            "status": tip.status,
351	        }

353	    def _winning_fork(self) -> tuple[str, list]:
354	        """Pick the winner among the canonical chain and every candidate.
355	
356	        Longest chain wins; equal lengths are broken by the smallest tip hash
357	        (lexicographic hex order). Returns (tip_hash, block list).
358	        """
359	        contenders: list[tuple[str, list]] = [
360	            (self.store.tip_hash(), self.store.chain)
361	        ]
362	        contenders.extend(self.store.forks.items())
363	        contenders.sort(key=lambda item: (-len(item[1]), item[0]))
364	        return contenders[0]

366	    def submit_fork_candidate(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
367	        """POST /v1/forks/candidates — validate and store a candidate fork.
368	
369	        Returns 201 with the fork descriptor S. Malformed or invalid forks
370	        return 400; a fork already known (identical to the canonical tip or an
371	        existing candidate tip) returns 409.
372	        """
373	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
374	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
375	        blocks_raw = payload.get("blocks")
376	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list):
377	            return 400, {"error": "missing field: blocks (must be a list)"}
378	        try:
379	            fork = self.store.validate_fork_blocks(blocks_raw)
380	        except ValueError as exc:
381	            return 400, {"error": str(exc)}
382	        summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
383	        # An exported fork (the five-field {tip_hash, height, length, status,
384	        # blocks} document) may be resubmitted verbatim; every supplied summary
385	        # field is re-verified against the recomputed descriptor.
386	        for field in ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status"):
387	            if field in payload and payload[field] != summary[field]:
388	                return 400, {"error": f"summary field {field!r} does not match the blocks"}
389	        tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
390	        with self.store.lock:
391	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
392	            # A tip hash equal to any canonical block hash means the candidate
393	            # is exactly the canonical chain or a prefix of it (the block hash
394	            # binds height, parent and Merkle root), so it carries nothing new.
395	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain):
396	                return 409, {"error": "fork is identical to the canonical chain"}
397	            if tip_hash in self.store.forks:
398	                return 409, {"error": "candidate fork already exists", "tip_hash": tip_hash}
399	            self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
400	            try:
401	                self.store.save()
402	            except BaseException:
403	                self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash, None)
404	                raise
405	        return 201, self._fork_summary(fork)

407	    def get_chain(self) -> tuple[int, dict]:
408	        """GET /v1/chain — canonical chain, candidates sorted by tip hash and
409	        the adoptable winner (a non-canonical chain that beats canonical).
410	        """
411	        with self.store.lock:
412	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
413	            canonical = self._fork_summary(self.store.chain)
414	            candidates = [
415	                self._fork_summary(self.store.forks[tip])
416	                for tip in sorted(self.store.forks)
417	            ]
418	            winner_tip, winner_chain = self._winning_fork()
419	            adoptable: list[dict] = []
420	            if winner_tip != self.store.tip_hash():
421	                adoptable.append(self._fork_summary(winner_chain))
422	            return 200, {
423	                "canonical": canonical,
424	                "candidates": candidates,
425	                "adoptable": adoptable,
426	            }

428	    def adopt_fork(self, tip_hash: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
429	        """POST /v1/forks/{tip_hash}/adopt — atomically switch to the winner.
430	
431	        Unknown tips return 404; adopting anything other than the current
432	        winning (longest / smallest-tip-hash) chain returns 409. Adoption
433	        replaces the canonical chain and mempool in one atomic write that
434	        advances the generation and rebuilds all indexes; transactions unique
435	        to the old chain's confirmed history return to the mempool, while
436	        pending-block transactions never enter it.
437	        """
438	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tip_hash):
439	            return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
440	        with self.store.lock:
441	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
442	            fork = self.store.forks.get(tip_hash)
443	            if fork is None:
444	                return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
445	            winner_tip, _ = self._winning_fork()
446	            if winner_tip != tip_hash:
447	                return 409, {"error": "only the winning fork can be adopted"}
448	            old_chain = self.store.chain
449	            old_pending = dict(self.store.pending)
450	            self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash)
451	            self.store.replace_chain(fork)
452	            # An adopted synced tip keeps its sync records (queryable until
453	            # expiry); record the adoption once per provenance entry. The
454	            # adopted tip summary is frozen from the adopted fork itself and
455	            # is never rewritten by later expiry.
456	            adopted_summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
457	            adopted_keys = sorted(
458	                key
459	                for key, rec in self.store.syncs.items()
460	                if rec["tip_hash"] == tip_hash
461	            )
462	            for rec_source, request_id in adopted_keys:
463	                self.store.append_audit_event(
464	                    EVENT_SYNC_ADOPTED,
465	                    {
466	                        "source": rec_source,
467	                        "request_id": request_id,
468	                        "tip_hash": tip_hash,
469	                        "expires_at": self.store.syncs[
470	                            (rec_source, request_id)
471	                        ]["expires_at"],
472	                        "height": adopted_summary["height"],
473	                        "length": adopted_summary["length"],
474	                        "status": adopted_summary["status"],
475	                    },
476	                )
477	            try:
478	                self.store.save()
479	            except BaseException:
480	                # Restore the pre-adoption in-memory state on a failed write.
481	                self.store.chain = old_chain
482	                self.store.pending = old_pending
483	                self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
484	                self.store.rebuild_derived()
485	                self.store.truncate_audit_events(len(adopted_keys))
486	                raise
487	            return 200, self._fork_summary(fork)

520	    def get_chain_range(self, params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
521	        """GET /v1/chain/range — the canonical blocks strictly after an anchor.
522	
523	        Query parameters: ``after_height`` (a non-negative decimal anchor
524	        height) and ``after_hash`` (the anchor block's hash, 64 lowercase hex
525	        characters), both required, plus ``limit`` (default 100, range 1-500).
526	        Every value must follow the strict decimal/hex format used by the
527	        other query endpoints; a repeated parameter is rejected by the HTTP
528	        layer.
529	
530	        Returns, under the store lock,
531	        ``{anchor, blocks, canonical, next_height}``: ``anchor`` is
532	        ``{height, block_hash}`` naming the block the page starts *after*;
533	        ``blocks`` are the complete blocks following it (full documents
534	        including transactions; a pending tip block is exported too), up to
535	        ``limit``; ``canonical`` is the current chain descriptor S;
536	        ``next_height`` is the height immediately after the returned page, or
537	        ``null`` when the page already ends at the chain tip. A well-formed
538	        but unknown anchor height returns 404; a malformed anchor hash returns
539	        400; an anchor hash that does not match the block at that height
540	        returns 409.
541	        """
542	        after_height_raw = params.get("after_height")
543	        after_hash = params.get("after_hash")
544	        if after_height_raw is None:
545	            return 400, {"error": "missing parameter: after_height"}
546	        if after_hash is None:
547	            return 400, {"error": "missing parameter: after_hash"}
548	        after_height = _parse_decimal(after_height_raw)
549	        if after_height is None:
550	            return 400, {"error": "after_height must be a non-negative decimal"}
551	        if not crypto.is_hex64(after_hash):
552	            return 400, {"error": "after_hash must be 64 lowercase hex characters"}
553	        limit = self.RANGE_DEFAULT_LIMIT
554	        if params.get("limit") is not None:
555	            parsed = _parse_decimal(params["limit"])
556	            if parsed is None or not 1 <= parsed <= self.RANGE_MAX_LIMIT:
557	                return 400, {"error": "limit must be a decimal between 1 and 500"}
558	            limit = parsed
559	
560	        with self.store.lock:
561	            anchor_block = self.store.block_at(after_height)
562	            if anchor_block is None:
563	                return 404, {"error": "anchor block not found"}
564	            if after_hash is not None and after_hash != anchor_block.block_hash:
565	                return 409, {
566	                    "error": "after_hash does not match the block at after_height"
567	                }
568	            page = self.store.chain[
569	                after_height + 1 : after_height + 1 + limit
570	            ]
571	            page_end_height = page[-1].height if page else anchor_block.height
572	            if page_end_height < self.store.chain[-1].height:
573	                next_height = page_end_height + 1
574	            else:
575	                next_height = None
576	            return 200, {
577	                "anchor": self._anchor_descriptor(anchor_block),
578	                "blocks": [block.to_dict() for block in page],
579	                "canonical": self._fork_summary(self.store.chain),
580	                "next_height": next_height,
581	            }

589	    def _candidate_blocks(candidate: object) -> object:
590	        """Normalize a sync ``candidate`` to its raw blocks list.
591	
592	        The candidate follows the existing export format (the five-field
593	        ``{tip_hash, height, length, status, blocks}`` document); the
594	        ``{"blocks": [...]}`` wrapper and a bare block list are accepted too.
595	        """
596	        if isinstance(candidate, dict):
597	            return candidate.get("blocks")

600	    @staticmethod
601	    def _candidate_fingerprint(blocks_raw: list) -> str:
602	        """Stable content fingerprint of a candidate's raw block list.
603	
604	        Used to decide whether a same-key retry carries the same candidate
605	        content. Key order and whitespace are normalized so two documents that
606	        serialize the same blocks identically compare equal.
607	        """
608	        return hashlib.sha256(
609	            json.dumps(blocks_raw, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
610	        ).hexdigest()

612	    def _prune_expired_syncs(self) -> list[str]:
613	        """Sweep expired sync records and persist the sweep atomically.
614	
615	        A candidate received through a sync lives only while its record is
616	        unexpired; on expiry both the record and its still-stored candidate fork
617	        are dropped, together and in a single atomic save that advances the
618	        generation. Candidates submitted directly (no sync record) never
619	        expire, and an adopted tip is no longer in ``forks`` (it is on the
620	        canonical chain), so its expiring audit record leaves the chain
621	        untouched. If the write fails the pre-cleanup records and forks are
622	        restored so no success is ever reported for an un-persisted sweep.
623	        Caller must hold the store lock. Returns the pruned tip hashes.
624	        """
625	        expired_tips, removed = self.store.prune_syncs()
626	        if not removed:
627	            return expired_tips
628	        removed_forks: dict[str, list] = {}
629	        canonical_hashes = {block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain}
630	        # The same tip could theoretically be referenced by another live
631	        # record; only drop a fork nothing still points at.
632	        live_tips = {rec["tip_hash"] for rec in self.store.syncs.values()}
633	        for tip in expired_tips:
634	            if tip in canonical_hashes or tip in live_tips:
635	                continue
636	            fork = self.store.forks.pop(tip, None)
637	            if fork is not None:
638	                removed_forks[tip] = fork
639	        # Record one permanent expiry event per removed sync record. A tip
640	        # already adopted onto the canonical chain still gets its event: the
641	        # record's expiry is auditable even though the chain is untouched. The
642	        # event freezes the originally delivered summary.
643	        for (rec_source, request_id), rec in sorted(removed.items()):
644	            self.store.append_audit_event(
645	                EVENT_SYNC_EXPIRED,
646	                {
647	                    "source": rec_source,
648	                    "request_id": request_id,
649	                    "tip_hash": rec["tip_hash"],
650	                    "expires_at": rec["expires_at"],
651	                    "height": rec.get("height"),
652	                    "length": rec.get("length"),
653	                    "status": rec.get("status"),
654	                },
655	            )
656	        try:
657	            self.store.save()
658	        except BaseException:
659	            # Restore the pre-cleanup state: a failed write must neither leave
660	            # the records gone nor their candidates orphaned, nor the events
661	            # durably visible.
662	            self.store.truncate_audit_events(len(removed))
663	            self.store.restore_syncs(removed, removed_forks)
664	            raise
665	        return expired_tips

667	    def _tip_descriptor(self, tip_hash: str) -> dict | None:
668	        """Resolve (height/length/status) for a synced tip.
669	
670	        Looks the candidate up among stored forks first, then among canonical
671	        blocks, so audit rows remain available after the candidate is adopted.
672	        """
673	        fork = self.store.forks.get(tip_hash)
674	        if fork is not None:
675	            return self._fork_summary(fork)
676	        for block in self.store.chain:
677	            if block.block_hash == tip_hash:
678	                return {
679	                    "tip_hash": block.block_hash,
680	                    "height": block.height,
681	                    # Length counts every block including the genesis block.
682	                    "length": block.height + 1,
683	                    "status": block.status,
684	                }
685	        return None

687	    def submit_fork_sync(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
688	        """POST /v1/forks/sync — receive a candidate chain from another node.
689	
690	        The request carries ``source``, ``request_id``, ``expires_at`` (Unix
691	        seconds) and ``candidate`` (an export-format fork document).
692	
693	        Authorization. A *new* source+request_id pair is accepted only when the
694	        source is registered in the persistent trust registry with status
695	        ``active`` and an ``expires_at`` still in the future. An unknown,
696	        revoked or registry-expired source is rejected 403 before the candidate
697	        is examined. A retry on a still-live recorded key bypasses the registry
698	        check entirely: the recorded result must keep replaying even after the
699	        source has since been rotated, revoked or expired.
700	
701	        After authorization (and only then) the candidate is re-validated
702	        exactly like a direct candidate submission (canonical genesis,
703	        consecutive heights and prev_hash linkage, recomputed block hashes and
704	        Merkle roots, tx_id and Ed25519 signatures, unique ascending tx_ids,
705	        endowment replay, pending-only-at-tip).
706	
707	        Status precedence: malformed envelope fields are 400; an unauthorized
708	        source is 403; a well-formed new request whose ``expires_at`` is not
709	        later than now is 410; a well-formed but failing candidate chain (or a
710	        tampered candidate summary) is 400. Returns 201 on first acceptance
711	        with ``{tip_hash, height, length, status, expires_at}``. A retry with
712	        the same source + request_id and identical content replays the original
713	        result as 200; the same key with different content returns 409, as does
714	        a duplicate tip already known.
715	        """
716	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
717	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
718	        for field in ("source", "request_id", "expires_at", "candidate"):
719	            if field not in payload:
720	                return 400, {"error": f"missing field: {field}"}
721	
722	        source = payload["source"]
723	        request_id = payload["request_id"]
724	        expires_at = payload["expires_at"]
725	        candidate = payload["candidate"]
726	
727	        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
728	            return 400, {"error": "field 'source' must be a non-empty string"}
729	        if not isinstance(request_id, str) or not request_id:
730	            return 400, {"error": "field 'request_id' must be a non-empty string"}
731	        if isinstance(expires_at, bool) or not isinstance(expires_at, int):
732	            return 400, {"error": "field 'expires_at' must be a Unix-seconds integer"}
733	
734	        blocks_raw = self._candidate_blocks(candidate)
735	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list):
736	            return 400, {"error": "field 'candidate' must contain a 'blocks' list"}
737	
738	        with self.store.lock:
739	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
740	
741	            key = (source, request_id)
742	            existing = self.store.syncs.get(key)
743	
744	            if existing is None:
745	                # Authorization gate for new deliveries only: the source must
746	                # be an active, unexpired entry of the persistent trust
747	                # registry. Unknown, revoked or registry-expired sources are
748	                # refused 403 before the candidate is examined. A retry on a
749	                # still-live key skips this, so a recorded result keeps
750	                # replaying even after the source has since been rotated,
751	                # revoked or expired.
752	                now = time.time()
753	                trusted = self.store.trust_sources.get(source)
754	                if (
755	                    trusted is None
756	                    or trusted["status"] != TRUST_ACTIVE
757	                    or trusted["expires_at"] <= now
758	                ):
759	                    return 403, {"error": "source is not an active trusted source"}
760	                # The request's own deadline is checked next, still before the
761	                # candidate chain is examined: a well-formed request whose
762	                # expiry is not later than now is gone (410).
763	                if expires_at <= now:
764	                    return 410, {"error": "sync request has expired"}
765	
766	            # Re-validate the whole candidate chain and recompute the tip
767	            # summary BEFORE any idempotency decision: a request whose supplied
768	            # tip_hash/height/length/status were tampered with must fail 400,
769	            # never be answered with the cached 200 for its source+request_id.
770	            try:
771	                fork = self.store.validate_fork_blocks(blocks_raw)
772	            except ValueError as exc:
773	                return 400, {"error": str(exc)}
774	            summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
775	            if isinstance(candidate, dict):
776	                for field in ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status"):
777	                    if field in candidate and candidate[field] != summary[field]:
778	                        return 400, {
779	                            "error": f"candidate field {field!r} does not match the blocks"
780	                        }
781	            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
782	            # Fingerprint the *canonicalized* parsed blocks, not the raw
783	            # request list, so recovery (which re-parses the stored fork)
784	            # recomputes an identical fingerprint regardless of insignificant
785	            # serialization differences in the original submission.
786	            canonical_blocks = [block.to_dict() for block in fork]
787	            fingerprint = self._candidate_fingerprint(canonical_blocks)
788	
789	            if existing is not None:
790	                # A retry on a live key is idempotent only when it carries the
791	                # identical candidate content; a changed body conflicts 409.
792	                if fingerprint != existing["fingerprint"]:
793	                    return 409, {
794	                        "error": "request_id already used with different content"
795	                    }
796	                # Replay the ORIGINAL result frozen at first reception; only
797	                # legacy records without a frozen summary resolve live.
798	                descriptor: dict | None = None
799	                if existing.get("height") is not None:
800	                    descriptor = {
801	                        "tip_hash": existing["tip_hash"],
802	                        "height": existing["height"],
803	                        "length": existing["length"],
804	                        "status": existing["status"],
805	                    }
806	                if descriptor is None:
807	                    descriptor = self._tip_descriptor(existing["tip_hash"]) or {
808	                        "tip_hash": existing["tip_hash"],
809	                        "height": None,
810	                        "length": None,
811	                        "status": None,
812	                    }
813	                return 200, {
814	                    "tip_hash": descriptor["tip_hash"],
815	                    "height": descriptor.get("height"),
816	                    "length": descriptor.get("length"),
817	                    "status": descriptor.get("status"),
818	                    "expires_at": existing["expires_at"],
819	                }
820	
821	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain):
822	                return 409, {"error": "fork is identical to the canonical chain"}
823	            if tip_hash in self.store.forks:
824	                return 409, {
825	                    "error": "candidate fork already exists",
826	                    "tip_hash": tip_hash,
827	                }
828	
829	            self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
830	            self.store.syncs[key] = {
831	                "tip_hash": tip_hash,
832	                "expires_at": expires_at,
833	                "fingerprint": fingerprint,
834	                # The tip summary is frozen at reception: later adoption or
835	                # expiry never rewrites it, so the history always reports what
836	                # was originally delivered.
837	                "height": summary["height"],
838	                "length": summary["length"],
839	                "status": summary["status"],
840	            }
841	            self.store.append_audit_event(
842	                EVENT_SYNC_RECEIVED,
843	                {
844	                    "source": source,
845	                    "request_id": request_id,
846	                    "tip_hash": tip_hash,
847	                    "expires_at": expires_at,
848	                    "height": summary["height"],
849	                    "length": summary["length"],
850	                    "status": summary["status"],
851	                },
852	            )
853	            try:
854	                self.store.save()
855	            except BaseException:
856	                # Roll back the candidate, its metadata and the audit event
857	                # together so a failed write never leaves one without the others.
858	                self.store.syncs.pop(key, None)
859	                self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash, None)
860	                self.store.truncate_audit_events(1)
861	                raise
862	
863	            result = dict(summary)
864	            result["expires_at"] = expires_at
865	            return 201, result

184	                # min_height=&max_height=&limit=&cursor=
185	                parsed = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
186	                if any(len(values) > 1 for values in parsed.values()):
187	                    self._send_json(
188	                        400, {"error": "query parameters must not be repeated"}
189	                    )
190	                    return
191	                params = {key: values[0] for key, values in parsed.items()}
192	                status, body = service.list_fork_sync_history(params)
193	                self._send_json(status, body)
194	            elif path == "/v1/forks/sync":
195	                # GET /v1/forks/sync?source=&min_height=&max_height=&limit=&cursor=
196	                params = {
197	                    key: values[0]
198	                    for key, values in parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True).items()
199	                }
200	                status, body = service.list_fork_syncs(params)
201	                self._send_json(status, body)
202	            elif path == "/v1/index/transactions":
203	                # GET /v1/index/transactions?tx_id=&account=&height=&limit=&cursor=
204	                params = {
205	                    key: values[0]
206	                    for key, values in parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True).items()
207	                }
208	                status, body = service.list_transactions(params)
209	                self._send_json(status, body)
210	            elif path.startswith("/v1/forks/") and path.endswith("/export"):
211	                # GET /v1/forks/{tip_hash}/export
212	                tip_hash = unquote(path[len("/v1/forks/") : -len("/export")])
213	                status, body = service.export_fork(tip_hash)
214	                self._send_json(status, body)
215	            elif path.startswith("/v1/blocks/"):
216	                remainder = path[len("/v1/blocks/") :]
217	                if "/proof/" in remainder:
218	                    # GET /v1/blocks/{height}/proof/{tx_id}
219	                    height_raw, tx_raw = remainder.split("/proof/", 1)
220	                    if not height_raw or not tx_raw:
221	                        self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
222	                        return
223	                    status, body = service.get_proof(unquote(height_raw), unquote(tx_raw))
224	                    self._send_json(status, body)
225	                elif remainder.endswith("/status"):
226	                    # GET /v1/blocks/{height}/status
227	                    height = unquote(remainder[: -len("/status")])
228	                    status, body = service.get_block_status(height)
229	                    self._send_json(status, body)
230	                else:
231	                    height = unquote(remainder)
232	                    status, body = service.get_block(height)
233	                    self._send_json(status, body)
234	            elif path.startswith("/v1/accounts/"):
235	                account = unquote(path[len("/v1/accounts/") :])
236	                if not account:
237	                    self._send_json(404, {"error": "account not found"})
238	                    return
239	                status, body = service.get_account(account)
240	                self._send_json(status, body)
241	            else:
242	                self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
243	
244	    return LedgerHandler
245	
246	
247	def serve(service: LedgerService, host: str, port: int) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
248	    """Create and run the HTTP server (blocks until interrupted)."""
249	    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), build_handler(service))
250	    httpd.serve_forever()
251	    return httpd

34	def _request(method: str, url: str, payload: dict | None) -> tuple[int, dict]:
35	    data = None
36	    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
37	    if payload is not None:
38	        data = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
39	        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
40	    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
41	    try:
42	        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
43	            return response.status, json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
44	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
45	        try:
46	            body = json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))
47	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
48	            body = {"error": exc.reason}
49	        return exc.code, body

63	def _load_signing_key(spec: str):
64	    """Load an Ed25519 private key from raw hex or an ``@file`` (hex or PEM)."""
65	    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
66	
67	    if spec.startswith("@"):
68	        with open(spec[1:], "rb") as fh:
69	            material = fh.read()
70	    else:
71	        material = spec.encode("ascii")
72	    stripped = material.strip()
73	    if stripped.startswith(b"-----BEGIN"):
74	        key = serialization.load_pem_private_key(stripped, password=None)
75	    else:
76	        raw = bytes.fromhex(stripped.decode("ascii"))
77	        if len(raw) != 32:
78	            raise ValueError("signing key must be 32 raw bytes (64 hex chars)")
79	        from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import (
80	            Ed25519PrivateKey,
81	        )
82	
83	        key = Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(raw)
84	    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey
85	
86	    if not isinstance(key, Ed25519PrivateKey):
87	        raise ValueError("signing key is not an Ed25519 private key")

426	    argument is ``-``. Prints a single JSON line:

428	    ``{"ok": false, "error": "input"|"integrity"|"auth"}`` on failure, and
429	    exits 0/1 respectively.

432	    its genesis anchor and ``audit_signers`` additionally authenticate every
433	    page's ``checkpoint_auth`` signature and bind the pages to one another.

444	        # Unreadable or non-JSON input is an input error.

1	"""Offline light-client verification of externally supplied proof bundles.
2	
3	A proof bundle lets a client verify ledger responses without trusting the
4	serving node or holding any chain state:
5	
6	    bundle = {
7	        "source": str,
8	        "expires_at": int,            # Unix seconds
9	        "response": object,           # the attested response object
10	        "candidate": [...],           # full block list starting at genesis
11	        "proofs": [                   # optional Merkle inclusion proofs
12	            {"height": int, "proof": {height, tx_id, index, merkle_root,
13	                                      block_hash, siblings}},
14	            ...
15	        ],
16	        "signature": str,             # optional Ed25519 signature hex
17	    }
18	
19	The local trust document pins the genesis block hash and records, per source,
20	an optional Ed25519 public key with its own expiry, plus an allowlist of
21	sources accepted without signatures:
22	
23	    trust = {
24	        "genesis_hash": "<64 lowercase hex chars>",
25	        "sources": {source: {"public_key": hex, "expires_at": int}},
26	        "allowlist": {source: expires_at_int},
27	    }
28	
29	Verification, in order:
30	
31	1. **input** — bundle and trust must have the documented shape; every numeric
32	   field must be a plain (non-boolean) integer.
33	2. **auth** — the source must be trusted (a ``sources`` entry or the
34	   ``allowlist``). A source with a public key must sign the bundle; a bundle
35	   carrying a signature for a key-less source, or an unsigned bundle from a
36	   non-allowlisted source, fails.
37	3. **expired** — neither the bundle deadline nor the trust entry's deadline
38	   may have passed (``expires_at <= now`` counts as expired).
39	4. **integrity** — the signature (when required) is verified over
40	   Ed25519(sha256(sorted-compact UTF-8 JSON of the bundle without
41	   ``signature``)); the candidate chain is recomputed from the pinned genesis
42	   (heights, prev_hash linkage, every transaction's tx_id and Ed25519
43	   signature, unique tx_ids, Merkle roots, block hashes, pending-only-at-tip)
44	   and the response's descriptor fields are checked against the recomputed
45	   tip descriptor ``S``.
46	5. **proof** — every proof must be unique, its tx_id/height/index and block
47	   fields must agree with the candidate block, the Merkle path must verify
48	   under the existing rules, and its block must not be the pending tip.
49	
50	On success :func:`verify_bundle` returns
51	``{"ok": True, "source", "S", "verified_tx_ids"}``; on failure
52	``{"ok": False, "error": category}`` with category one of
53	``input/auth/expired/integrity/proof``.
54	"""
55	from __future__ import annotations
56	
57	import hashlib
58	import json
59	import re
60	import time
61	
62	from . import crypto
63	from .models import STATUS_CONFIRMED, Block, compute_block_hash
64	from .store import GENESIS_PREV_HASH
65	
66	# Stable error categories returned to callers.
67	ERR_INPUT = "input"
68	ERR_AUTH = "auth"
69	ERR_EXPIRED = "expired"
70	ERR_INTEGRITY = "integrity"
71	ERR_PROOF = "proof"
72	
73	# Descriptor fields of a chain tip, exactly as GET /v1/chain reports them.
74	DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS = ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status")
75	
76	# An Ed25519 public key rendered as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
77	_HEX32_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}")
78	
79	
80	class _Failure(Exception):
81	    """Internal control-flow exception carrying the public error category."""
82	
83	    def __init__(self, category: str) -> None:
84	        self.category = category
85	        super().__init__(category)
86	
87	
88	def _is_int(value: object) -> bool:
89	    """Plain integer test; booleans are rejected (bool subclasses int)."""
90	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
91	
92	
93	def canonical_bundle_bytes(bundle: dict) -> bytes:
94	    """Sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of the bundle with its signature removed.
95	
96	    This is the exact byte document whose SHA-256 the source signs, so signers
97	    and verifiers always agree regardless of incoming key order. The
98	    serialization mirrors :func:`ledger.crypto.canonical_message`: sorted keys,
99	    compact separators, UTF-8 bytes.
100	    """
101	    unsigned = {key: value for key, value in bundle.items() if key != "signature"}
102	    return json.dumps(
103	        unsigned, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
104	    ).encode("utf-8")
105	
106	
107	def bundle_signing_digest(bundle: dict) -> bytes:
108	    """The 32-byte SHA-256 digest covered by a bundle Ed25519 signature."""
109	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bundle_bytes(bundle)).digest()
110	
111	
112	def verify_bundle(bundle: object, trust: object, now: float | None = None) -> dict:
113	    """Verify an offline proof bundle against the local trust document.
114	
115	    Returns ``{"ok": True, "source": ..., "S": ..., "verified_tx_ids": [...]}``
116	    on success or ``{"ok": False, "error": category}`` on failure. Never raises
117	    for malformed input: every defect maps to one of the five categories.
118	    """
119	    current = time.time() if now is None else now
120	    try:
121	        source, candidate = _validate_inputs(bundle, trust)
122	        _authenticate(bundle, trust, source, current)
123	        blocks_raw = candidate["blocks"] if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate
124	        blocks = _recompute_chain(blocks_raw, trust)
125	        descriptor = _tip_descriptor(blocks)
126	        _check_candidate_summary(candidate, descriptor)
127	        _check_response(bundle["response"], descriptor)
128	        verified_ids = _verify_proofs(bundle["proofs"], blocks)
129	    except _Failure as failure:
130	        return {"ok": False, "error": failure.category}
131	    except Exception:
132	        # Defensive: structurally unforeseeable inputs must report rather than
133	        # crash the verifying process.
134	        return {"ok": False, "error": ERR_INPUT}
135	    return {
136	        "ok": True,
137	        "source": source,
138	        "S": descriptor,
139	        "verified_tx_ids": verified_ids,
140	    }
141	
142	
143	# -- stage 1: shape -----------------------------------------------------------
144	
145	
146	def _validate_inputs(bundle: object, trust: object) -> tuple[str, object]:
147	    """Structural validation of bundle and trust.
148	
149	    Returns ``(source, candidate)`` where ``candidate`` is the raw candidate
150	    value (a bare block list or an export-format object carrying ``blocks``).
151	    The bundle itself is never mutated: the signature covers it verbatim.
152	    """
153	    if not isinstance(bundle, dict):
154	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
155	    for field in ("source", "expires_at", "response", "candidate", "proofs"):
156	        if field not in bundle:
157	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
158	    source = bundle["source"]
159	    if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
160	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
161	    if not _is_int(bundle["expires_at"]):
162	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
163	    # The response is itself a JSON object; anything else cannot be checked
164	    # against the recomputed chain descriptor.
165	    if not isinstance(bundle["response"], dict):
166	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
167	    candidate = bundle["candidate"]
168	    blocks_raw = candidate.get("blocks") if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate
169	    if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
170	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
171	    if not isinstance(bundle["proofs"], list):
172	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
173	    signature = bundle.get("signature")
174	    if signature is not None and (not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature):
175	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
176	
177	    if not isinstance(trust, dict):
178	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
179	    if not crypto.is_hex64(trust.get("genesis_hash")):
180	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
181	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
182	    if not isinstance(sources, dict):
183	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
184	    for name, entry in sources.items():
185	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(entry, dict):
186	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
187	        if not _is_int(entry.get("expires_at")):
188	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
189	        public_key = entry.get("public_key")
190	        # Ed25519 public keys are 32 raw bytes, i.e. 64 hex characters.
191	        if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not _HEX32_RE.fullmatch(public_key):
192	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
193	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
194	    if not isinstance(allowlist, dict):
195	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
196	    for name, expires_at in allowlist.items():
197	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _is_int(expires_at):
198	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
199	    return source, candidate
200	
201	
202	# -- stage 2/3: trust, expiry and signature -----------------------------------
203	
204	
205	def _authenticate(
206	    bundle: dict, trust: dict, source: str, now: float
207	) -> None:
208	    """Check source trust, every deadline and the optional Ed25519 signature."""
209	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
210	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
211	    source_entry = sources.get(source)
212	    allowlist_expiry = allowlist.get(source)
213	    if source_entry is None and allowlist_expiry is None:
214	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
215	
216	    # All deadlines are checked before any signature work: an expired,
217	    # correctly-signed bundle is still unusable. A source listed in both
218	    # ``sources`` and ``allowlist`` is bound by both deadlines.
219	    if bundle["expires_at"] <= now:
220	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
221	    if source_entry is not None and source_entry["expires_at"] <= now:
222	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
223	    if allowlist_expiry is not None and allowlist_expiry <= now:
224	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
225	
226	    public_key = source_entry.get("public_key") if source_entry else None
227	    signature = bundle.get("signature")
228	    if public_key is not None:
229	        # A keyed source must sign: a missing signature cannot authenticate.
230	        if signature is None:
231	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
232	        if not crypto.verify_signature(
233	            public_key, bundle_signing_digest(bundle), signature
234	        ):
235	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
236	        return
237	    # The source reached this point only through the allowlist (every sources
238	    # entry pins a key). An unsigned allowlisted bundle is therefore accepted;
239	    # a signature with no pinned key to check it against is meaningless.
240	    if signature is not None:
241	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
242	
243
